verdict.rationale: Kick's docs confirm native invoicing: you can create and send invoices directly from Kick, view invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury and BILL, and AR is included on the Plus plan. Nothing in the evidence shows online payment options on invoices or tracking of when an invoice is viewed or paid. missing for 10: online payment options on invoices, viewed/opened tracking, paid-status notifications, in-depth invoicing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: View invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL, and create and send invoices directly from Kick.
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
